questions.question: What is the Tournament Mode?
questions.answer: The tournament mode is a fun game where you answer questions on different topics to win points and see how you compare with others.

questions.question: Who Can Play?
questions.answer: To join the tournament mode, you need to have: a 2-day quiz streak, OR complete 3 quizzes under 30 minutes, OR complete 6 quizzes in a day, OR achieve an RQM score greater than 42 in 2 quizzes in a day. This ensures you're ready to compete!

questions.question: When Can I register for the tournament?
questions.answer: You can register for the tournament between Monday and Friday, until 11 PM. Don't worry, you'll have plenty of time to get ready.

questions.question: How to Choose Topics?
questions.answer: When signing up, you will pick 3 categories from a list like Sports, Technology, Health, and more. Plus, an additional category named Current Affairs is selected automatically.

questions.question: When Does the Tournament Happen?
questions.answer: The tournament takes place on Saturday and Sunday. You can play anytime during these two days, so it is really flexible.

questions.question: How Does the Quiz Work?
questions.answer: You will have to answer 5 questions from 3 categories you picked, plus the Current Affairs category and for each category you will get 2 attempts in which we will take the best of both the attempts. But be quick – you have only 50 seconds for each set of questions!

questions.question: How Can I See My Score and Ranking?
questions.answer: After you finish, your score and ranking will show up on a special leaderboard in tournament tab. You can see how well you did compared to other players right away.

questions.question: How can I earn badges in a tournament?
questions.answer: You can earn badges based on your performance in the tournament. Participants who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd overall will receive Hall of Fame badges. In specific categories, those who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd will receive Ace, Pro, and Champ badges, respectively. Additionally, participants who finish in the top 5%, 10%, and 25% of the tournament leaderboard will receive corresponding badges. All other participants will be awarded the Quiz Warrior badge. These badges will be displayed on your profile page and the main leaderboard of Rapid Recap.

questions.question: Where Do the Questions Come From?
questions.answer: The quiz questions will come from the 3 categories you have selected when registering for tournament, plus the Current Affairs category (2 attempts for each category), which are about things that happened worldwide in the past week. This keeps everything fresh and exciting!

questions.question: Why Should I Play?
questions.answer: It is a great way to learn new things, challenge yourself, and compete with others. Plus, it is fun to see your name rise on the leaderboard!
